crossRefs.note: The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;
I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be…
He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and…
Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with beautiful branches, and with a forest-like shade, of high stature; and…

translations.web: Thus were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the middle of the earth; and its height was great.
translations.bsb: In these visions of my mind as I was lying in bed, I saw this come to pass: There was a tree in the midst of the land, and its height was great.
translations.kjv: Thus were the visions of mine head in my bed; I saw, and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and the height thereof was great.
translations.asv: Thus were the visions of my head upon my bed: I saw, and, behold, a tree in the midst of the earth; and the height thereof was great.
